value.rationale: The repaired example identifies the first stage count at which a context-free approach breaks, even with equal durations and all rates strictly positive. The two unique optima show the obstruction is not merely an irrelevant local comparison inside two suboptimal schedules. This makes it a reusable benchmark for ordering in serial Markov models, while explicitly excluding empirical intervention claims and general algorithmic impossibility.
